selection_reasoning: The task 'find honey_block' is a single atomic task that is well-suited for a benchmark: it requires the agent to visually identify and navigate to a honey_block placed in the scene. Honey blocks have a distinctive golden/amber appearance, making them visually identifiable. This task tests the agent's ability to explore, recognize a specific block, and navigate toward it. It doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just visual recognition and movement. As a single task, the dependency graph is trivial (one node, no edges), but the task itself can be made interesting through scene design (e.g., placing the honey block in a location that requires exploration).

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the honey_block (at spawn-relative [7, 1, 7] inside the oak building) and face toward it, confirming visual identification. max_distance=5 allows the player to be inside the building or at the doorway. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking in the honey block's direction.

scene_description: A flat grassy area with three small structures: (1) an oak plank building containing a honey_block, accessible via a 2-block-high doorway on the front face; (2) a stone brick enclosure as a distractor; (3) a cobblestone arch as another distractor. The player must explore the area and enter the oak building to find the honey_block.
task_text: Find the honey_block hidden inside one of the small buildings in this area.

design_notes.scene_layout: Honey_block at ~7 ~1 ~7 inside oak building (walls ~5-~9 X/Z, floor ~0, ceiling ~4 with oak slabs). Doorway at ~7 ~1-2 ~5 faces player spawn. Stone brick enclosure (~-5 to ~-3, ~6 to ~8) and cobblestone arch (~-6 to ~-3, ~-3) serve as distractors. All structures within 12 blocks of spawn.
design_notes.task_difficulty: Easy-medium. Requires basic exploration and visual identification. Honey block has distinctive golden/amber semi-transparent texture that contrasts with oak plank walls.
design_notes.minecraft_knowledge_required: Minimal — player needs to recognize a honey_block visually. No crafting, mining, or special tools needed.
design_notes.verification_history: Scene verified across 3 sandbox preview runs. All structures confirmed built correctly. Honey block placement confirmed. Doorways accessible. No critical command errors.
